faq.title: Answers to the questions people ask most often.

items.question: How quickly can I open an account?
items.answer: Most applicants can complete the initial setup in under ten minutes, with account access often available shortly after verification.

items.question: Are there monthly maintenance fees?
items.answer: Many of our everyday accounts are designed to be low friction, and fee details are shown clearly before a decision is made.

items.question: Can I send money to friends and family?
items.answer: Yes. Instant transfers and scheduled payments are available within the digital banking experience for supported account types.

items.question: How do I protect my card if it goes missing?
items.answer: You can pause or freeze a card right away from the app, then reactivate it whenever you are ready.

items.question: What are the daily transaction limits?
items.answer: Limits vary by account and activity type, and the app provides a clear view of the current rules before each transfer.

items.question: What support hours are available?
items.answer: Support is available around the clock for account and security questions, with live assistance during extended business hours.

items.question: Can I set savings goals?
items.answer: Yes. You can create goal-based saving plans, automate transfers, and track progress from a single dashboard.

items.question: Do you offer card controls for online purchases?
items.answer: Our app includes controls for spending patterns, card activity, and transaction alerts so you can stay aware of what is happening.
